Services.heading: What we code
Services.intro: Fixed prices where we can give them, honest “on request” where the car decides. Most jobs can be done in person or remotely — hardware retrofits are in-person only.
Services.footnote: Don’t see your exact request? Hidden features and bespoke coding are part of the job — message us the car and what you want, and we’ll tell you straight whether it’s possible.

HowItWorks.heading: Four steps, no dealer queue
HowItWorks.step1Body: Message the model, year and what you want — CarPlay, ambient light, a fault to chase. We confirm if it’s codable.
HowItWorks.step2Body: Choose what suits you: we come to the car around Dublin, or you connect remotely — for that you need a laptop and an ENET cable.
HowItWorks.step3Body: In person we arrive with the tooling and plug in; remotely we connect over ENET. Either way we code or diagnose and show it working.
HowItWorks.step4Body: You see the result before you pay. Card or cash on completion. No dealer trip, no waiting room.

Faq.q1: Will coding affect my BMW warranty?
Faq.a1: Coding changes software parameters that already exist in your car — it is reversible and we can return any setting to factory before a dealer visit. We will always tell you up front if a specific request is likely to be flagged.
Faq.q2: Which BMW models do you cover?
Faq.a2: F and G series across NBT, NBT Evo and MGU (iDrive 6/7/8) head units. Send us your model, year and VIN-derived build and we will confirm exactly what is possible on your car.
Faq.q3: Do I need to drive anywhere?
Faq.a3: Usually not. For in-person work we come to your home, workplace or wherever the car is parked across Dublin and the surrounding counties. We also offer remote coding — you stay where you are and connect a laptop with an ENET cable to the car while we work. A call-out fee applies for visits — see below.
Faq.a4: On completion, once you have seen the feature working. Card or cash. Prices for diagnostics and conversions are confirmed before we start so there are no surprises.
Faq.q5: Can you retrofit hardware, not just code?
Faq.a5: Yes — ambient lighting, cruise control and similar retrofits that need wiring or modules can be scoped. These are in-person jobs and some need parts ordered first, so message us early and we will quote the full job.
Faq.q6: My import is Japanese spec — can you convert it?
Faq.a6: Japan→EU conversions are a regular job: region change, FSC, ETC mirror handling and TCB considerations. Send the details and we will tell you what your specific car needs.
Faq.q7: Do you charge for coming to my car?
Faq.a7: Yes — a call-out fee applies to in-person visits: €20 around Dublin, then €1.25 per km beyond, measured from our base in Rathcoole, west Dublin. You are always told the exact travel cost before you book. There is no call-out fee for remote coding over ENET.
